timeline.evidenceText: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

definitions.short: Gedor , a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H1446. Gedor גְּדֹר גְּדוֺר, proper name (Arabic wall ); — 1. proper name, of a location city of Judah גְּדוֺר Josh 15:58 ; also as proper name, masculine, under figure of Genealogy גְּדֹר son of Penuel 1Chr 4:4 , גְּדוֺר son of Yered 4:18 ; also הַגְּדוֺר 12:7 see d. H.; הַגְּדוּד Baer, compare his note. 2. proper name, of a location גְּדֹר 1Chr 4:39 , but read Gerar, according to ᵐ5 Ew Hi Be and others 3. proper name, masculine גְּדוֺר 1Chr 8:31 ; 9:37 a Benjamite, of Gibeon. I. גדשׁ (Late Hebrew גָּדַשׁ , Aramaic גְּדַשׁ , heap up ; compare also Arabic ).
